messages.author: 40878654752107e5
messages.subject: Re: problems in authentication with LDAP on shiny-server (required_group doesn't work)
parts:
Hi CJ,

The problem is most likely that you don't have the user inside the group.  You need to add `memberuid: uid=admin1,ou=Users,dc=witness,dc=com` to the posixGroup.  You can do that by adding an ldif file like:  

```
dn: cn=witnessManagers,ou=Groups,dc=witness,dc=com
changetype: modify
add: uniqueMember
uniqueMember: uid=admin1, ou=Users,dc=witness, dc=com
```

I wrote up a little bit more about my implementation in a blog post here:  https://www.gastrograph.com/blogs/dev/shiny-and-ldap.html

The problem was solved now, both the configure of LDAP and shinyserver have no problem, it just because I used the ldapscript command "ldapadduser username groupname" to add a new user, and I think the user will be assigned to the group "groupname", 
use command :  ldapadd -x -D cn=admin,dc=example,dc=com    to check find the if it was added to the group, "gidNumber: 10000" shows something . but it actually didn't work with "required_group". 

solve:Then I use "ldapaddusertogroup username groupname" try again, it start work !! 

I'm a bit confused about why "ldapadduser username groupname" not add the user to the group we provided??? anybody give a interpretation,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,


Thanks Evan, especially Fereshteh who helped me solve the problem finally. Hope it is helpful to you!
